text:
About 2.2% of the property was affected: Hansen Global Forest Change shows 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss in 2021 on a 3,643.5 ha asset (2.23%).

- **Corroboration:** The JRC 2020 reference maps 98% of the event area as forest, and a later year of the series (up to 2025) is observed. Both parts of the corroboration rule are met.
- **Forest type:** The MGAP 2021 map classes 68.1 ha as planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), 0 ha as native forest, and 13.2 ha as outside mapped forest. The loss is therefore mostly plantation, probably harvesting rather than deforestation. The data does not say what caused it.
- **Small patches:** A further 37.3 ha was lost in patches under 0.5 ha. These are not counted as events and are not in the 2.23% figure.

The engine is early access (land-change/1), so treat the result with some caution.
